  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 18, 2019

11:30 a.m. – Small Executive Conference, 9th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the November 04, 2019, meeting.

  2. Ace Business Machines, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  annual service contract renewal for the check endorser machine.

  3. Fiesta Martin Bar & Grill – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  providing food service for the 2019 Halloween Activities.

  4. Lotus Communication LLC - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  providing service to run network cable throughout the City.

  5. Quality Equipment Rentals – Executive session to discuss recommended payments for
  equipment rentals for City repairs.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  November 18, 2019

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was held in the Small Executive Conference
Room, 9th floor at 11:37 a.m.:

  Members Present: Yvonne Horton, City Clerk Department
  Wanda Brown, City Treasurer Department
  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Ken Campos, Legal Department

  Staff Present:  Tony Nguyen, ITC Department
  Steven Ycute, Water Operations Department
  Brandon Ely, Facilities Department
  Sabrina Barnes, Parks, Recreation Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

  1. The minutes of November 04, 2019, meeting was approved as recorded.

  2. Ace Business Machines, Inc. – Item pulled.

  3. Fiesta Martin Bar & Grill – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  providing food service for the 2019 Halloween activities in the amount of $4,400.00.
  Motion carried unanimously.

  4. Lotus Communication LLC – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  providing network cabling and infrastructure throughout the City in the amount of $4,
  654.00. Motion carried unanimously.

  5. Quality Equipment Rentals - Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  equipment rentals for City repairs in the amount of $782.16. Motion carried
  unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
  Maria Heaney reported no public comments.
 Claims Review Committee  November 04, 2019

  There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 12:01 p.m. Adjournment
